title: Party guest list
hints: Check the two "no" cases first, in the order the prompt lists them. Only append when both checks pass.
`name in guests` tells you whether someone is already invited. `len(guests) >= capacity` tells you whether the list is full.
`if name in guests: return "already invited"`, `if len(guests) >= capacity: return "full"`, then `guests.append(name)` and `return "added"`
